channel.title: Spatial Omics Radar — email digest
channel.description: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

item.title: Weekly update · 37 new entries
item.description:
37 new entries this week, spanning transcriptomics, histology / imaging-only, proteomics, metabolomics, and 2 more.

Serval
Modular computational framework for decoding imaging-based spatial transcriptomics data.

InSTability
Computes per-spot clustering instability scores across repeated spatial transcriptomics clustering runs.

STAVelo
Graph attention encoder-decoder infers spatially-aware RNA velocity from spatial transcriptomics data.

SpatialOmicsLab
Integrated environment and LLM-based AI co-scientist that assembles and runs spatial transcriptomics analysis workflows.

ASTRA
Pretrained model performs zero-shot super-resolution reconstruction of spatial transcriptomics across capture geometries.

mzQC
JSON-based standard and toolset for reporting quality-control metrics across mass spectrometry workflows, including imaging.

GRASS-MIL
Graph multiple-instance learning framework that predicts phenotypes and decomposes predictions into signed neighborhood contributions.

VINTER
Vision-language model jointly reading histology, expression and neighborhood to annotate and interrogate tissue regions.

Point-Process Modelling of Cell-Type Interaction Structure in CosMx Glioma Data for Hypothesis-Driven Tumor Inference from scRNA-seq
Log-Gaussian Cox Process framework modeling cell-type spatial interactions to predict tumor-proximity phenotypes.

AlphaFISH
Sequencing-free subcellular spatial profiling platform with transformer model linking host transcriptome and microbiome.

stLearn
Machine learning pipeline combining morphology, expression and spatial location to analyse spatial transcriptomics data.

STAgent
Multimodal LLM agent enabling conversational deep research over spatial transcriptomics datasets.

Scicore-Omics
Tri-modal foundation model jointly embedding histology images, spatial transcriptomics and biological language.

stFormer
Transformer foundation model pretrained on spatial transcriptomics incorporating ligand signaling via cross-attention.

OpenFISH
Open-source modular spatial transcriptomics platform with workflow for same-section MALDI-MSI co-mapping.

spMosaic
Batch-aware dual-encoder autoencoder framework for scalable multi-sample spatial domain discovery.

Cell2space
Deep learning framework that reconstructs multi-scale spatial cell organization from scRNA-seq using spatial references.

ST-ConMa
Multimodal foundation model using contrastive and matching learning to fuse tissue images with gene expression.

ctdecon
Self-supervised contrastive learning module deconvolving cell-type proportions per spot using scRNA-seq references.

stPularity
Purity-constrained Louvain clustering on spatially smoothed cell-type proportion vectors for domain identification.

SpaHCC
Heterogeneous graph learning framework integrating scRNA-seq, spatial data and ligand-receptor priors to infer cell-cell communication.

SpiderNet
Interpretable representation-learning framework discovering recurrent sender-receiver cell communication programs from spatial transcriptomics.

iSiT
Imaging-based method and probe toolkit resolving transcript isoform diversity at cellular/subcellular resolution on Xenium.

AtlasOT
Fused unbalanced Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport framework for within-sample multimodal single-cell/spatial integration.

NexuST
Hierarchical foundation model pretrained on 45.7M cells for cell annotation, region and gene prediction.

SpatialTRACE
Predicts tissue-wide anatomical axes and regions from spatial transcriptomics and DAPI microscopy.

GeneSPOT
Gene-centric framework quantifying spatial relationships among genes and their reorganization across conditions.

ProxiNet
Learns cellular proximity signatures from spatial data and transfers them to dissociated single-cell transcriptomes.

SFUMATO
GPU-accelerated Bayesian Gaussian mixture clustering giving uncertainty-aware, segmentation-free spatial transcriptomics maps.

spEnhance
Framework that reconstructs high-resolution spatial molecular profiles from spot-level data with calibrated uncertainty.

OCTAVE
Scoring framework that evaluates histology-based gene expression predictions across spatial scale bands.

RAMP
Rank-preserving alignment framework enabling joint analysis of single-cell and spatial proteomics data across different platforms.

MSI.EAGLE
Modifies DESI-MSI hardware for subcellular resolution and adds open-source registration/clustering tools.

ST-DISTAL
Dual-branch graph convolution with distributional alignment for spatially coherent cell-type deconvolution.

SpaReg
Sparsity-based 3D reconstruction method aligning serial sections across histology, spatial proteomics and transcriptomics.

milume
Interactive notebook widget layering images, cells, and transcripts for spatial omics exploration.

Sopa
Nextflow pipeline implementation of Sopa for spatial omics segmentation and analysis.
